Class Model

java.lang.Object
Model
public class Model extends Object
Tracks the current GameState and Save Information.

Source of all information regarding the state of the game, the progress of the Player, and the details of the Dungeons.

  • Method Details

    • generateSaveList

      public void generateSaveList()
      Generates a random list of 3 idols for the player to save. Currently rigs the first idol to save to be Chika Takami in Yasudaya Ryokan.

    • tickDungeon

      public boolean tickDungeon(char choice)
      Processes one cycle of user input.

      Calls the Dungeon.tick method to process the choice and changes there. If the method returns true, then the dungeon is finished. Passes on the return value back to Controller for it to process.

      Parameters:
      choice - the input character representing the player's choice.
      Returns:
      true if the Dungeon has been finished, false if not. This notifies the Controller if the dungeon is finished.
